plan.title: Reject Vendor Bid Without Rebid Permission

steps.note: Open the prepared RFQ's buyer Responses tab, which is the required starting screen.
Enable the required eRFX project configuration before accessing the prepared RFQ.
Confirm the response view identifies Vendor A as the vendor whose bid will be rejected.
Open the reject-bid dialog for Vendor A's bid.
Verify that the rejection dialog opened.

args.text: Are you sure you want to reject this bid by Vendor A

steps.note: Verify the dialog names Vendor A and asks for rejection confirmation.
Enter the required rejection remark.
Confirm the exact rejection reason is present in the dialog.
Leave rebidding permission disabled for Vendor A.

args.text: Supplier would not be allowed to bid again. This action cannot be undone.

steps.note: Verify the warning for blocking the supplier from bidding again.
Confirm the rejection.

args.text: You have blocked the supplier from bidding again.

steps.note: Verify Procol confirms that Vendor A was blocked from rebidding.
Verify the rejected response shows the saved reason on the buyer's screen.
Open the comparison grid to verify Vendor A is removed from ranking and award consideration.
Verify only Vendor B remains as a ranked vendor in Master QCS.
Verify the remaining Vendor B bid is ranked as the best available bid.
Open the RFQ stage's Rejected Bids view.

args.text: Rejection Remark: Price not valid — QA

steps.note: Verify the Rejected Bids list records the exact rejection remark.
Switch to Vendor A's supplier portal view.
Open the rejected RFQ in Vendor A's pricing view.
Verify Vendor A can see the rejection reason in the supplier portal.
Verify the vendor portal marks Vendor A's bid as rejected.
